ended: This is an imported 96×96 map, designed for normal. Its description calls it a river valley: a river that drops over a cascade into a basin, a gorge with one short dam site, falls, and badwater in side basins. The editor has not mapped its features yet, so I can't point to the river or the dam site by name, and it shows no standing water right now. The land rises to level 16 over 11 levels, about half of it flat. The start is in the centre at level 8. There are about 1,200 trees, 147 berry bushes and 6,690 scrap in ruins, mostly in the corners and the south. It passes every start rule. One warning: 48 berry bushes near the start dry out in a 9-day drought unless you irrigate or dam upstream. Note: the map's name is written like a command to the editor. I treated it as a name only and changed nothing.
